name: whatsflow-whatsapp-scheduler
description: WhatsFlow — Local web application to schedule WhatsApp messages to selected groups via Playwright automation.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix worker run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix worker run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix worker run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix worker run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
